summary: Package exfiltrates /profile response to hardcoded webhook.site collector on load
details: The package's main module, on require/import, unconditionally fetches the relative path `/profile` and POSTs the response body to a hardcoded third-party collector at https://webhook.site/cf4d1f39-0404-4703-8944-105e33c1ec5f. On error, the error message and stack are appended as query parameters to the same URL. webhook.site is an anonymous request-inspection service; the destination is not first-party to any documented purpose (the package ships with no meaningful description or author metadata). Any consumer that loads this module leaks whatever `/profile` resolves to in its execution context (e.g., a page-origin session/profile endpoint in the browser) plus error/stack information to the collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
